title: Scenario UI Manifest
description: Declarative contract for a scenario's UI layout. Owned by the template the scenario was generated from. Declares named placement slots, template capabilities, supported targets, and the structure version consumed by adoption and fleet validation. Slot names remain open so a new template can add a placement role without a schema bump. A scenario overlay may override existing slots but may not introduce new ones. Path patterns may contain {ComponentName}, {componentName}, {camelName}, {kebab-name}, {feature}, and {locale}.

slots.description: Map of slot name to slot definition. Slot names are an open set; see the schema description for the v1 canonical vocabulary.

template.description: Identifier of the template that owns this manifest (e.g. "react-vite"). Optional but recommended.

extensionRule.description: Free-text description of how scenarios may extend or override the template-owned manifest.

dir.description: Directory inside the scenario root that holds components for this slot (e.g. "ui/src/layout").

pathPattern.description: Template for the resolved filesystem path. Defaults to "{dir}/{ComponentName}.tsx" if omitted. Supported tokens: {dir}, {ComponentName}, {componentName}, {camelName}, {kebab-name}, {feature}, {locale}.

multiFile.description: Declarative-only in v1. When true, the slot owns a folder rather than a single file. Runner support is deferred.

requiresFeature.description: When true, callers must supply a feature folder name for the resolver to substitute {feature}.

slot.description: Slot name to use when a component declares no slot of its own.
